title: urn:qauth:ia:password_reset:v1-rc.0
description: A path marker: answering it starts a reset. The next step is `email_code` with `purpose` `recovery` for every address, known or not; mail goes only to a known address with a password. A reset never unlocks an account whose strongest authenticator is stronger than email (ADR-017 Decision 8).

login_hint.description: The identifier: today an email address of at most 254 bytes in UTF-8 (ADR-017 Decision 3). The schema counts characters; the server counts bytes, checks the full email syntax and normalises the address before use. Sent only when the transaction holds no identifier yet.

amr.description: The RFC 8176 `amr` values a successful answer adds to the transaction: none, because the step proves no authenticator.
